t: This is the site of the former Brixton Theatre, in Brixton, in the London Borough of Lambeth. It was designed by Frank Matcham, one of the great English theatre architects. Matcham specialised in theatres and music halls, and over a forty-year career he was responsible for more than ninety new theatres and the refurbishment of around eighty more across the United Kingdom. In London he worked on the Hippodrome, Hackney Empire, Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum, the Palladium and the Victoria Palace. So this building belongs to a very famous body of work.
